desc:
HEARTY NUT MEDLEY: This sweetened whole grain oat and wheat cereal combines the goodness of Cheerios with the texture and nutrition of flakes, almonds, and seeds

EXCELLENT SOURCE OF FIBER: Every serving has the irresistible taste of maple cinnamon flavored with other natural flavor and an excellent source of fiber (6g of total fat per serving)

HEART HEALTHY CEREAL: Diets rich in whole grain foods and other plant foods, and low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may help reduce the risk of heart disease

WHOLE GRAIN FIRST INGREDIENT: A serving has 33g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) with 11 vitamins and minerals, and a good source of calcium

CONTAINS: One 20 oz Family Size cereal box of Cheerios Hearty Nut Medley Maple Cinnamon Flavored Cereal
features:
Features

Hearty Grain Blend

Offers a mix of oats, flakes, and seeds to create a satisfying, textured cereal.

Warm Maple Cinnamon Flavor

Naturally flavored for a cozy, subtly sweet taste that doesn’t overpower.

Nut and Seed Boost

Almonds and pumpkin seeds provide crunch, heart-healthy fats, and additional protein.

High Fiber Content

Excellent for digestion and fullness, with 6g of fiber in every serving.

Balanced Nutrition

A good source of multiple essential nutrients, making it more than just a tasty breakfast.

Quick and Convenient

Great for busy mornings—just pour and enjoy.

Benefits

Keeps You Full Longer

The combo of fiber, protein, and fats makes it a filling meal that helps control mid-morning hu

Supports Heart Health

Whole grains, nuts, and seeds contribute to a heart-friendly diet.

Perfect Texture Mix

Crunchy flakes, chewy oats, and nutty bits offer a fun and satisfying bite.

Nutritious and Tasty

A great balance of flavor and health—enjoyable without being overly sweet.

Versatile Use

Enjoy as breakfast, a snack, or a crunchy topping on yogurt or smoothie bowls.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Almonds, Soluble Corn Fiber, Pumpkin Seeds, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Maple Syrup, Corn Starch, Salt, Cinnamon, Tripotassium Phosphate, Natural Flavor, Annatto Extract Color. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), A B Vitamin (calcium pantothenate), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
